name: @vismay/curious-pipeline
description: The Curious Desk's provenance-first claim pipeline: the LLM path (llm.ts: web-search research, proposal, page-checked grading; llmStore.ts writes the review queue), and the older source policies, polite fetching, collectors (GDELT, Library of Congress, Europeana, Gallica), candidate detection, atomic-claim extraction, lineage-aware dedupe, explicit-feature grading and the Supabase store. Pure modules take an injected fetch so they test on fixtures; store.ts is server only. Its own package so pipeline changes only rebuild admin and the vizmaya-fyi scripts.

scripts.test: tsx src/pipeline.test.ts && tsx src/llm.test.ts && tsx src/book.test.ts
